items.title: What admissible means
items.prompt: A heuristic h(n) is admissible when:

examEligibility.rationale: Practice-pool item: never exam-eligible by design; kept separate from the exam pool to protect exam integrity.

hints: Rule out each option that contradicts the definition, then check what is left.

feedback.correct: Correct. Admissible means h(n) is at most the true remaining cost. With an admissible heuristic, tree-search A* returns an optimal path.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Admissible means h(n) is at most the true remaining cost. With an admissible heuristic, tree-search A* returns an optimal path.

criteria.description: Selects the option consistent with the definition.

privateAuthorNotes: Owner content review: check wording, correctness and distractor quality.

options.text: It never overestimates the true cost to reach the goal
It never underestimates the true cost
It always equals the true cost

answer.explanation: Admissible means h(n) is at most the true remaining cost. With an admissible heuristic, tree-search A* returns an optimal path.
